sh.title: Shimmer
sh.sub: Every travelling light on the shop: on or off, speed and strength.

master.title: All shimmers on the shop
master.on: On: each shimmer below follows its own switch.
master.off: Off: no shimmer anywhere on the shop.
master.motion: A phone or computer set to reduce motion never shows any shimmer, whatever the switches say.

list.title: Each shimmer
list.sub: As designed: every shimmer on except Add to Bag, normal speed, full strength. Strength never goes above the designed level, which keeps the words under the light easy to read.

item.pdpWords: Product page words (free delivery, colour, size, all colours, in stock)
item.pdpPills: Size boxes on the product page
item.checkoutHelp: Checkout help strip ("Need help with your order?")
item.checkoutNeed: Checkout button while something is still missing

more.title: More options
more.sub: What slow, fast, medium and soft mean. Slow and fast multiply each shimmer's designed pass time; medium and soft are a share of its designed brightness.

sh.saved: Saved. The shop shows it now.
sh.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved yet.
